moved.sentence: Features that may need experimentation SHOULD support variant assignment via an `ExperimentProvider` interface (`variant(key) -> String`).

judged.note: The rule keeps the same SHOULD, the same scope (features that may need experimentation) and the named ExperimentProvider interface returning a String variant by key. The signature now adds a caller-supplied default and is marked as an example, but the old parenthetical was illustrative too, so nothing is weakened.

moved.sentence: Local default with debug panel override.

judged.note: The old fragment carried no requirement keyword. The rule makes the local default a MUST and, in an app, requires the override to be the debug panel's variant picker, so it says at least as much as before.
